scope: Targeted legal-portal public-user, technology, accessibility, deployment, marketplace, and source review

items.finding: Users could organize dates, source findings, action plans, drafts, and binders, but lacked one factual chronology for calls, messages, meetings, observations, preservation status, and follow-up.
items.actionNow: Add a deterministic device-only Communication & Evidence Log with local text/JSON export and explicit evidence, recording, deadline, storage, and professional-sharing limits.
items.monitorTrigger: User feedback, accessibility failure, or evidence that the workflow duplicates rather than connects existing tools.

items.finding: Node 22 remains an LTS line and newer patched Node 22 releases exist beyond the exact build runtime v22.16.0.
items.actionNow: Preserve the 22.x architecture and require a current supported Node 22 patch in deployment acceptance rather than an unneeded major migration.
items.monitorTrigger: A Node 22 security release, end-of-life milestone, or hosting runtime change.

items.finding: Focus visibility, target size, consistent help, redundant entry, and accessible authentication remain material to public and professional workflows.
items.actionNow: Use explicit labels, native keyboard-operable controls, visible status output, clear error recovery, and no authentication barrier in the new public workflow.
items.monitorTrigger: New WCAG guidance, accessibility complaint, or failed real-device/assistive-technology acceptance.

items.source: Controlled npm ci and npm audit attempts
items.finding: The configured npm registry timed out; no clean-install or current vulnerability result can be claimed.
items.actionNow: Keep dependencies unchanged, package no test shims, preserve fail-closed truth, and rerun clean install/audit when registry access is available.
items.monitorTrigger: Registry availability or a dependency advisory.

items.source: Artifact behavior, privacy boundaries, and current activation gates
items.finding: External AI for sensitive content and confidential production uploads remain unapproved and lack live operational evidence.
items.actionNow: Keep the new log deterministic and device-only rather than collecting files, recording communications, or transmitting content.
items.monitorTrigger: Approved provider, private storage, privacy, security, retention, support, and human-escalation evidence.

items.source: Current professional-controlled firm, office, roster, and attorney pages reviewed 2026-07-24
items.finding: Qualifying Phase One inventory remained available across all six priority regions, including the Queens lead region.
items.actionNow: Add 36 source-tracked attorneys and 6 firms while retaining unclaimed, independently unverified, unpaid, non-participating, unavailable, and inquiry-ineligible states.
items.monitorTrigger: Source staleness, correction or claim request, duplicate finding, or documented geographic diminishing returns.

rejectedTrends.trend: Record calls, capture messages, or collect evidence files in the new public tool
rejectedTrends.reason: That would create consent, privacy, storage, metadata, security, jurisdiction, and operational burdens without approved infrastructure; a user-entered local index provides safer immediate value.

rejectedTrends.trend: Activate external AI to judge evidence or communications
rejectedTrends.reason: No approved provider, evidence-authentication method, privacy/retention system, or human-escalation acceptance exists; the tool must not fabricate authenticity or legal significance.
No verified material user benefit over the supported Node 22.x architecture in this release; patch-level currency is the appropriate action.

rejectedTrends.trend: Open uploads, payments, booking, reviews, or unrestricted routing
rejectedTrends.reason: Required production infrastructure, professional-responsibility, support, and live acceptance evidence remain unavailable.
